name: C^3-Benchmark
intro: C3-Bench 是面向 LLM Agent 多任务鲁棒性的开源基准。五角色框架生成 256 条单任务和 768 条相关多任务数据，并以复杂工具依赖、关键隐藏信息和可变决策轨迹三项挑战，诊断上下文与策略变化如何影响 Agent。
build_method: 五角色LLM生成框架, 目标轨迹与隐藏策略采样, 启发式Checker, 五位专家多轮复核
metric: Accuracy, Accomplish Progress, Optimal Path Rate, Policy Transition Frequency, Volatility Factor, Debiased Descent Direction
task_type: 多任务Agent, 工具调用, 上下文依赖, 决策轨迹鲁棒性
eval_feature: 完整有效路径枚举, 增量决策树匹配, Omit/Reference/Long控制, Challenge 2/3配对比较
scale: 256条单任务, 768条多任务; 2-4个相关任务; 336种策略切换类型; 49个Agent
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.18746v4 and the official Tencent Hunyuan repository. The diagram preserves real-user-log analysis as design evidence while stating that test data are not copied from logs; the User/Planner/AI Agent/Tool/Checker framework and fifteen subtypes; desired-trajectory and four-policy sampling; serial, parallel, and mixed multi-tool forms; HunYuan-Series user generation, HunYuan-TurboS execution generation, Omit/Reference/Long hiding; Checker heuristic review; five-expert self-check, cross-check, and senior review; 256 single-task and 768 multi-task entries with 336 policy-switch types; DFS topological enumeration and incremental decision-tree matching; correct-history isolation in Challenge 2; injected action-observation histories in Challenge 3; and Accuracy, AP, OP Rate, PTF, VF, and DDD across 49 agents.
task_type_en: Multi-task agent, tool calling, context dependency, decision-trajectory robustness
build_method_en: Five-role LLM generation framework, target-trajectory and hiding-strategy sampling, heuristic Checker, multi-stage review by five experts
eval_feature_en: Complete valid-path enumeration, incremental decision-tree matching, Omit/Reference/Long controls, paired Challenge 2/3 comparison
intro_en: C3-Bench is an open benchmark for LLM-agent robustness under multi-tasking. A five-role framework generates 256 single-task and 768 related multi-task examples, while three controlled challenges isolate complex tool dependencies, critical hidden information, and variable decision trajectories.
